listing.title: Darshan Live
listing.short_description: One-to-one live video darshan connecting devotees with verified temple sevaks.
listing.full_description:
Darshan Live connects devotees worldwide with authorized on-site temple sevaks for personalized one-to-one live video darshan.

Key Features:
• Permitted Temple Directory: Discover authorized shrines including Kashi Vishwanath, Tirupati Balaji, Siddhivinayak, Somnath, Mahakaleshwar, and Meenakshi Amman with sanctum timings, deity details, and permitted darshan focus areas.
• Online Verified Sevaks: View sevaks currently on duty at each temple. Read verified sevak profiles including seva experience, languages spoken, and devotee ratings prior to requesting darshan.
• 200m GPS Geofence Verification: Broadcasters must be physically present within 200 meters of the sacred sanctum coordinates to activate live streaming, ensuring authentic on-site darshan.
• Temple-Issued Sevak Authorization: Volunteers verify their identity with official temple authorization codes to receive certified provider credentials.
• Personalized 1-to-1 Darshan Requests: Submit your family Sankalpa prayer, Gotra names, and specific darshan focus (Garbhagriha, Aarti view, or Parikrama corridor) directly to available sevaks.
• Live Video Darshan Screen: Experience high-definition video darshan with camera controls, picture-in-picture devotee view, ambient sanctum soundscape, and sacred screenshot blessing captures.
• Voluntary Dakshina & Offerings: Contribute digital offerings and flower seva via integrated Razorpay payment gateway with instant 80G tax exemption receipts.
• Local History & Records: Review completed temple darshans, seva history, and digital donation certificates stored securely on your device.

Permissions Used:
• Location: Used to confirm physical presence within the temple's 200m sacred boundary.
• Camera & Microphone: Required for 1-to-1 two-way video and audio darshan communication.
